title: Deliver remaining integration and platform capability families
what: Expand the parity inventory into executable tickets for additional SCM, issue trackers, communication and incident integrations; API and external-agent handoff; analysis, review and security workflows; enterprise identity, secrets, audit and usage controls; CLI/Desktop, voice and multi-OS execution. Prioritizing Slack, GitHub and Notion must not erase these requirements.

acceptance.text: Each inventory family has concrete behavior-level tickets and dependencies before implementation
Supported integrations pass real authentication, read/write, retry and revocation checks
Infrastructure and account blockers identify the exact prerequisite and do not block unrelated authorized work
No family is declared complete from tool availability or mocks alone
